user.title: Connect Equilab
user.description: Unofficial read-only integration. Sign in with your Equilab account. Your password is not stored; a refresh token is saved in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Equilab
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with the same Equilab account.

error.access_denied: Equilab denied access to the account document.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Equilab. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Equilab is rate limiting requests. Wait before retrying.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally configured.

init.title: Default sync interval
init.description: Default interval for horses and riders without a per-device override. Configure each device using its Sync interval entity. Groups default to daily. Changing this setting does not reset device overrides.
